Alex — thanks for the notes and the questionnaire (received). Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps below. Forwarding to Rishi for technical details and to Grace for commercial/retention pricing.

Summary answers (short):
- SOC 2: Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II report (most recent completed Nov 2026). We can share the report under NDA — see attached high-level summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).
- GDPR / DPA: We support EU data residency in select regions and have a standard DPA; can add EU-only routing for request data.
- HIPAA: We support HIPAA-covered workflows on Dedicated and Private deployments; we sign BAAs when customers require them. Hosted customers can use encryption and strict data partitioning but require Dedicated/Private for full BAA coverage.
- Admin activity & API logs: We capture admin console changes, API request metadata (timestamps, endpoint, authenticated principal, API key ID, HTTP status), and admin actions (user grants, role changes, key rotations). Logs are exportable as compressed JSONL or CSV and can be delivered to customer S3, or pulled via API. Default retention for hosted is 90 days; can extend via an add-on to 1, 3, or custom years for Dedicated/Private.
- Immutability: Write-once immutability (WORM) is available for Dedicated and on-prem/private via object-lock controls and append-only ledger mode. Hosted offering can provide signed, time-stamped exports but does not have host-managed WORM for tenant logs.

Action items / next steps:
1) Rishi: can you confirm the exact fields in the API log JSON (request_id, user_id, method, path, response_code, latency_ms, client_ip, user_agent, and any payload hashes), attach sample schema and an export sample?
2) Grace: please prepare a short quote for CarePulse for retention extension to 1 year and for a Dedicated trial if they need BAA + WORM.
3) Alex: would you be available for a 30-min follow-up week of Aug 29 to walk through sample exports and attachment of the SOC 2 report under NDA? Calendly link below.

Drive folder (shared): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example-redwood-carepulse
Schedule: https://calendly.com/naomi-redwood/30min

Thanks — Naomi

Naomi / Alex — quick technical clarifications and attaching the log schema sample (audit_log_spec.xlsx). Highlights below: 

- Captured events: admin console changes (create/delete/update user, role changes, auth provider config changes), API calls (create/completion/generate endpoints), auth failures, key rotations, quota changes, and system-initiated maintenance events.
- Log fields: request_id, timestamp (ISO8601), principal_id, principal_type (user/service), api_key_id (when used), method, endpoint, http_status, response_size_bytes, latency_ms, client_ip (redacted on request), user_agent, resource_id, action, payload_hash (sha256 of request body when applicable).
- Export formats: NDJSON (gzipped), CSV (for tabular exports) — NDJSON recommended for fidelity.
- Delivery mechanisms: S3 push (preferred), secure HTTPS pull API, and for Dedicated/Private we can mount an export to a customer bucket automatically.
- Retention & immutability: Hosted: default 90d, extendable via paid retention addon but exported files are snapshots (signed) rather than host-managed WORM. Dedicated/Private: object lock + append-only ledger support; we can also support immutable S3 buckets (object lock governance/compliance modes).
- Sampling / redaction: we can provide redacted sample logs (PII removed) for review. For PHI/HIPAA flows, we recommend Dedicated/Private + BAA.

Attached: audit_log_spec.xlsx (includes sample NDJSON lines and field descriptions). I also added a small redacted sample (see sheet "sample_redacted").

If Alex wants, I can drop a 10-line redacted NDJSON snippet in the Drive folder ahead of the call.

—Rishi
